title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval a-Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Hallmark Health System, Inc., d/b/a Melrose Wakefield Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement.
